name: Microsoft sign-in
description: Signs a OneDrive or SharePoint account in through Microsoft's own authorization endpoint, by browser or by device code.

codes.onedrive_oauth.bad_reply: Microsoft sent a reply this plugin could not read.
codes.onedrive_oauth.code_expired: The sign-in expired before it was finished, or the code was not accepted. Start it again.
codes.onedrive_oauth.consent_denied: The sign-in was not granted at Microsoft. A tenant administrator can also require consent or block it.
codes.onedrive_oauth.no_entropy: The sign-in could not be started because the application had no randomness for it. Try again.
codes.onedrive_oauth.refresh_refused: Microsoft no longer accepts the stored sign-in. Sign in again.
